note: acquia_perz_push is the export engine submodule of acquia_perz. It adds Drush commands (QueueCommands: acquia:perz-enqueue-content, acquia:perz-process-queue, acquia:perz-queue-items, acquia:perz-purge-queue, acquia:perz-purge-current, acquia:perz-purge-all), two admin forms gated by 'administer acquia perz push', two queue workers, a tracking table acquia_perz_push_export_tracking, and config object acquia_perz_push.settings with cis.queue_bulk_max_size (default 20) and cis.endpoint_timeout (default 2). Medium reads back a known cis.queue_bulk_max_size; hard sets cis.endpoint_timeout to a target value and verifies against live config.

evals.prompt: Using the acquia_perz_push module, which Drush commands do I run to (a) scan and enqueue all personalization-eligible content, and (b) push the queued content to Acquia Personalization?
evals.expected_output: Run 'drush acquia:perz-enqueue-content' (alias ap-ec) to rescan and enqueue content, then 'drush acquia:perz-process-queue' to export the queued items to CIS. Use 'drush acquia:perz-queue-items' to see the queue count.

evals.prompt: Which configuration object and keys control the bulk export chunk size and the CIS request timeout in acquia_perz_push, and what are the default values?
evals.expected_output: Config object acquia_perz_push.settings holds cis.queue_bulk_max_size (default 20) and cis.endpoint_timeout (default 2 seconds). There is no settings form; set them with drush cset.

evals.prompt: How does acquia_perz_push know which entities have already been exported to Acquia Personalization? Name the database table and the service that manages it.
evals.expected_output: It records every export in the acquia_perz_push_export_tracking table (created in hook_schema), managed by the ExportTracker service (acquia_perz_push.tracker) with statuses exported/export_timeout/deleted/delete_timeout/failed.

evals.prompt: This site has acquia_perz_push installed and its bulk export chunk size has been customized. Inspect the live configuration and tell me the current bulk queue max size.
evals.expected_output: The bulk queue max size is 37, at acquia_perz_push.settings -> cis.queue_bulk_max_size (drush cget acquia_perz_push.settings cis.queue_bulk_max_size).

evals.prompt: On this site the Acquia Personalization exports are timing out on a slow network. Using acquia_perz_push, raise the CIS endpoint timeout to 10 seconds in the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: acquia_perz_push.settings -> cis.endpoint_timeout is set to 10 (drush cset acquia_perz_push.settings cis.endpoint_timeout 10 -y).
